verdict.rationale: LegalOS publishes its own preparation timeline: attorney-reviewed filings 'in as little as 48 hours' for startups and 'filing readiness in 48–72 hours' for enterprise. Government processing times are only implied. A blog post says it covers 'timeline' for H-1B sponsorship, and the fee calculator covers Premium Processing fees, but no USCIS processing durations are quoted. Missing for 10: published government/USCIS processing-time estimates per visa category, prep timelines broken out by case type, independent corroboration of the 48–72 hour claim.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on
